description: This file defines the exported API functions for the Sys Recycle Bin Object within the BroadWay Runtime System environment. It contains function prototypes for creating, removing, enrolling objects, and initializing the object, primarily serving as a header declaration for external use.

methods.name: SysCreateRecycleBin
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the Sys Recycle Bin object with specified contexts.

methods.name: SysRboCreate
methods.description: Initializes and creates the Sys RBO object with given contexts.

methods.name: SysRboRemove
methods.description: Removes and cleans up the Sys RBO object instance.

methods.name: SysRboEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls necessary objects into the Sys RBO instance.

methods.name: SysRboInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the Sys RBO object, setting up essential configurations.
